intro: If you have tickets to Rajamangala National Stadium and still need a place to stay, here is the answer — The Quarter Ramkhamhaeng by UHG sits on Ramkhamhaeng Road in Hua Mak, just 1.9 km from Rajamangala — around five minutes by Grab · It is a newer 4-star hotel under the UHG group: 338 clean modern rooms, a panoramic rooftop pool on the 31st floor, a sky bar, gym, sauna, and breakfast · MRT Orange Line Ramkhamhaeng 12 Station is right outside the door, and ARL Hua Mak is 1.5 km away for a direct 25-minute link to Suvarnabhumi Airport · Scored 9.0 from 1,936 reviews on Trip.com · from around ฿900/night

body.html: Who is this hotel for? · In a sentence: The Quarter Ramkhamhaeng by UHG is the smartest 4-star option for anyone attending a concert or sporting event at Rajamangala National Stadium — Thailand's largest venue, which hosts major international acts year after year — who wants a clean, contemporary hotel with a rooftop pool rather than trekking back to Sukhumvit at midnight · The stadium is just 1.9 km away, about five minutes in a Grab, or a twenty-to-twenty-five-minute walk if the night air is pleasant · Beyond the concert crowd, the hotel works well for anyone with business in the Bang Kapi or Ramkhamhaeng area, anyone connecting via ARL Hua Mak to Suvarnabhumi Airport, and groups arriving by car who want free parking without paying Sukhumvit hotel rates

Location and getting around · The address is 73 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok 10240 · The most important transit fact: MRT Orange Line Ramkhamhaeng 12 Station is directly adjacent — essentially a minute's walk across the road — connecting you to Siam, Pratunam, Ratchadaphisek, and the Democracy Monument / Sanam Luang area without needing a car · For the airport, ARL Hua Mak is about 1.5 km away, a short Grab ride or a brisk walk, and the Airport Rail Link runs direct to Suvarnabhumi in roughly 25 minutes — a real advantage over most hotels in the city · Rajamangala National Stadium is at 286 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Hua Mak, and is 1.9 km from the hotel · The Mall Ramkhamhaeng shopping centre is around 500 metres away, a solid option for a pre-show dinner or supplies · The honest location note is that this is not a tourist-central neighbourhood: getting to Sukhumvit or Siam requires the MRT or a Grab, and the surrounding streets lean local rather than international

"Stayed here for the BLACKPINK concert at Rajamangala — the location was perfect, just a short Grab to the venue. The staff were super friendly and the room was clean and very comfortable. We had a great stay!"

Rooms · All 338 rooms are designed in a clean contemporary style — neutral tones, quality furnishings, and a noticeably fresh feel that reads newer than many competitors at this price point · The main categories available are: Deluxe Room, the entry option, with a king or twin bed, work desk, flat-screen TV, mini-fridge, kettle, and safe; Deluxe Corner Room with City View, which catches two-sided views of the Bangkok skyline and is particularly sought after on concert nights; Studio Suite with Bathtub, a step up in space with a soaking tub for winding down after a long show; and Executive One-Bedroom Suite with a separate living area that suits small groups or families wanting more room · Real guest reviews consistently highlight how clean and quiet the rooms are — the insulation from street noise is better than expected

Facilities — pool, gym, sauna · The standout feature, mentioned in almost every positive review, is the panoramic rooftop swimming pool on the 31st floor — 360-degree views of Bangkok, especially beautiful at sunset when the city light comes up · Adjacent to the pool is the Hilltop Sky Bar, which serves cocktails and snacks and is a genuinely pleasant spot to decompress after a high-energy concert · Fitness facilities are well-regarded: the gym is fully equipped and spacious, and both a sauna and steam room are included — the kind of recovery tools that make the morning-after much easier · The hotel also provides free parking across two lots, which is a real differentiator for groups arriving by car, and 24-hour front desk, Wi-Fi throughout, and laundry service

Restaurant Hilly's and breakfast · The hotel's all-day dining restaurant Hilly's covers breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a menu spanning Thai and international dishes · Breakfast reviews are generally positive — guests describe a solid spread of Thai, Asian, and Western options — though a handful mention they would like a wider variety at peak times · It is worth noting that the Bang Kapi neighbourhood has plenty of local restaurants within a short walk or Grab, covering everything from street food to mall dining at The Mall Ramkhamhaeng · Practical tip: on concert nights, Hilly's and nearby restaurants fill up quickly — booking a table or eating before showtime is the smarter move

Service · Service scores are among the hotel's strongest numbers: Trip.com gives it 9.0 for service and Booking.com also returns 9.0 for staff · Guests describe the front desk team as quick, warm, and good at solving problems · The BLACKPINK concert review quoted above is a useful snapshot: the hotel handled a full house of concert-goers without the service slipping · Occasional reviews mention some inconsistency in front desk information when the hotel is at full capacity, but this is a minor note against a backdrop of overwhelmingly positive feedback

What real guests say — the good and the honest · Drawing from Trip.com, Booking.com, and TripAdvisor: what guests consistently praise is the rooftop pool and its views ("worth every baht just for the pool"), clean and fresh-feeling rooms, friendly and attentive staff, the free parking which is rare at this level, and the convenient location for Rajamangala events · What gets flagged: the location is off the beaten tourist track — Sukhumvit is accessible but requires the MRT or a ride, not a walk; a few reviewers noted low shower water pressure; the occasional finding of hair or dust in the bathroom appeared in isolated reviews; and on busy concert nights the hotel fills entirely, making early booking essential · None of these are dealbreakers, and most relate to the character of the neighbourhood rather than the hotel's own shortcomings

"The rooftop pool has stunning views across Bangkok — I genuinely did not expect it at this price. Staff were incredibly helpful, clean rooms, free parking for our group of four. Perfect base for the concert."

Price and value · Deluxe Rooms start from around ฿900–1,000 per night in the low season (Trip.com shows averages around US$22, roughly ฿780) and climb to ฿1,500–2,500 or more during high season and concert-night spikes · Deluxe Corner City View and Studio Suite rooms step up accordingly, while the Executive Suite is priced for those wanting maximum space · The value proposition is strong for a 4-star hotel: a rooftop pool with city views, gym, sauna, steam room, and two lots of free parking are amenities that hotels in Sukhumvit at this price rarely include all at once · For a group of friends driving in for a Rajamangala show — free parking, multiple rooms at 4-star prices, a recovery pool and sky bar — the deal is genuinely hard to beat

What to know before you book · First, concert nights at Rajamangala sell out the whole neighbourhood: book this hotel months in advance with free cancellation · Second, the two free parking lots are ample but fill on big event nights — alert the front desk if you are arriving as a multi-car group · Third, ARL Hua Mak is 1.5 km away; a short Grab is easier than walking with luggage or late at night · Fourth, the adjacent MRT Orange Line is the most practical tool for daytime exploring — it covers a wide arc of Bangkok without needing a car · Fifth, Rajamangala is an open-air stadium, so check the weather forecast and dress accordingly — the rooftop pool and steam room back at the hotel make an excellent cooldown afterward

faq.q: How far is The Quarter Ramkhamhaeng by UHG from Rajamangala National Stadium?
faq.a: The hotel is 1.9 km from Rajamangala National Stadium — approximately 5 minutes by Grab · This makes it one of the closest 4-star options to the stadium; after a late show you can be back in your room before most of the crowd has cleared the exit gates

faq.q: Which is the nearest MRT or train station?
faq.a: The closest station is MRT Orange Line Ramkhamhaeng 12, which is directly adjacent to the hotel (a minute's walk) · The line connects to Siam, Pratunam, Ratchadaphisek, and the Old City area · For the airport, ARL Hua Mak is about 1.5 km away — a short Grab ride — and runs direct to Suvarnabhumi Airport in roughly 25 minutes

faq.q: What facilities does The Quarter Ramkhamhaeng have?
faq.a: Key facilities include a panoramic outdoor rooftop pool on the 31st floor, Hilltop Sky Bar, a fully-equipped gym, sauna, steam room, all-day dining restaurant Hilly's, free parking in two lots, 24-hour front desk, and free Wi-Fi throughout · 338 rooms total

faq.q: What does a room cost and what room types are available?
faq.a: Deluxe Rooms start from around ฿900/night in the low season, rising to ฿1,500–2,500 or more on high-demand nights · Room categories include Deluxe Room, Deluxe Corner Room with City View (great for the skyline), Studio Suite with Bathtub, and Executive One-Bedroom Suite · Always compare Agoda, Booking.com, and Trip.com and book early for concert dates

faq.q: Is this hotel good for attending concerts at Rajamangala?
faq.a: Yes — it is designed for exactly this use case · 1.9 km away by road (5 min Grab), free parking for groups with cars, rooftop pool and steam room for recovery, and a full-service 4-star hotel experience · One important note: the hotel fills months in advance for major events — book as early as possible with free cancellation

faq.q: What is breakfast like at The Quarter Ramkhamhaeng?
faq.a: Breakfast is served at Hilly's, the hotel's all-day dining restaurant, with Thai, Asian, and Western options · Most reviews rate it positively — described as tasty with a reasonable variety — though a few guests mention they would like more choices at busy times · The Mall Ramkhamhaeng and local restaurants nearby offer good alternatives for other meals
